{{Quote|May I suggest, Admiral, that the stalled campaign off Ketaris requires your attention?|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Last" />}}
The '''battle of Ketaris''' was one of the last battles in the [[Thrawn campaign]].

[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] launched the campaign of [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]] a week before his [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|death]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was still on an inspection tour of the planet's wreckage when the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Siege of Coruscant|struck]] the [[Coruscant/Legends|Galactic capital]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces resisted and were initially successful in defending the system. Eventually, with a renewed attack, the Imperial forces under [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] were victorious.
